note: v2 promotion gate stage5 -> stage6 (measurable, provisional policy; floors set before the run). Tool use is judged by behaviour, not one score: the model must route to the correct tool on a real fraction of held-out tool prompts AND must not call a tool when none is needed (false-positive rate capped). Prior reasoning/knowledge must not regress. Floors, not targets; see docs/training/tinymind-v2-50m-plan.md.
